import dataclasses

import pytest

from trailhead.pace import naismith_hours
from trailhead.report import Summary, format_summary, summarise

KM = 1 / 111.19508  # degrees of arc per kilometre along a meridian or the equator


@pytest.fixture
def climb(make_track):
    # 10 km due north, climbing 600 m: 10/5 + 600/600 = 3 hours.
    return make_track(
        (0, 0, 1000), (5 * KM, 0, 1300), (10 * KM, 0, 1600), name="Climb"
    )


def make_summary(**overrides):
    values = dict(
        name="Walk",
        length_km=12.3,
        gain_m=450.0,
        loss_m=120.0,
        highest_m=2100.0,
        lowest_m=1500.0,
        steepest_pct=18.0,
        hours=5.0,
        heading="NE",
    )
    values.update(overrides)
    return Summary(**values)


def test_summary_fields(climb):
    summary = summarise(climb)
    assert summary.name == "Climb"
    assert summary.length_km == pytest.approx(10.0, abs=0.05)
    assert summary.gain_m == 600.0
    assert summary.loss_m == 0.0
    assert summary.highest_m == 1600
    assert summary.lowest_m == 1000
    assert summary.hours == pytest.approx(3.0, rel=1e-3)
    assert summary.heading == "N"


def test_length_is_rounded_to_a_tenth(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 12.3456 * KM, 0))
    assert summarise(track).length_km == 12.3


def test_hours_use_unrounded_length(make_track):
    # 0.04 km rounds to 0.0 km, but the time must come from the true length.
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 0.04 * KM, 0))
    summary = summarise(track)
    assert summary.length_km == 0.0
    assert summary.hours == pytest.approx(0.04 / 5)


def test_hours_not_rounded(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 7.77 * KM, 0))
    assert summarise(track).hours == pytest.approx(7.77 / 5, rel=1e-6)


def test_fitness_divides_time(climb):
    base = summarise(climb).hours
    assert summarise(climb, fitness=1.25).hours == pytest.approx(base / 1.25)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("fitness", [0, -1])
def test_bad_fitness_is_an_error(climb, fitness):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        summarise(climb, fitness=fitness)


def test_hours_match_naismith(climb):
    summary = summarise(climb, fitness=0.8)
    assert summary.hours == pytest.approx(naismith_hours(10.0, 600.0, 0.8), rel=1e-3)


def test_jitter_is_ignored_by_default(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 100), (0, KM, 101), (0, 2 * KM, 100), (0, 3 * KM, 102))
    summary = summarise(track)
    assert (summary.gain_m, summary.loss_m) == (0.0, 0.0)


def test_threshold_is_passed_through(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 100), (0, KM, 102), (0, 2 * KM, 100))
    summary = summarise(track, threshold=1)
    assert (summary.gain_m, summary.loss_m) == (2.0, 2.0)


def test_negative_threshold_is_an_error(climb):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        summarise(climb, threshold=-1)


def test_small_steps_still_add_up(make_track):
    track = make_track(*[(0, i * KM, 100 + i) for i in range(101)])
    assert summarise(track).gain_m == 100.0


def test_descent_counts_as_loss_and_adds_no_time(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 1600), (5 * KM, 0, 1000))
    summary = summarise(track)
    assert summary.gain_m == 0.0
    assert summary.loss_m == 600.0
    assert summary.hours == pytest.approx(1.0, rel=1e-3)
    assert summary.heading == "N"


def test_steepest_is_percent(make_track):
    # 18 m over 100 m.
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0.1 * KM, 0, 18))
    assert summarise(track).steepest_pct == 18.0


def test_steepest_counts_downhill(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 100), (0.1 * KM, 0, 82))
    assert summarise(track).steepest_pct == 18.0


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("lat", "lon", "expected"),
    [
        (1, 0, "N"),
        (1, 1, "NE"),
        (0, 1, "E"),
        (-1, 1, "SE"),
        (-1, 0, "S"),
        (-1, -1, "SW"),
        (0, -1, "W"),
        (1, -1, "NW"),
    ],
)
def test_heading_is_compass_point_from_start_to_finish(make_track, lat, lon, expected):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (lat, lon, 0))
    assert summarise(track).heading == expected


def test_heading_ignores_the_route_between(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), (0, 1, 0), (1, 0.001, 0))
    assert summarise(track).heading == "N"


def test_out_and_back_is_a_loop(make_track):
    track = make_track((42, 23, 0), (42.1, 23.1, 0), (42, 23, 0))
    assert summarise(track).heading == "loop"


def test_finish_within_100m_is_a_loop(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), (0.09 * KM, 0, 0))
    assert summarise(track).heading == "loop"


def test_finish_just_over_100m_has_a_compass_heading(make_track):
    track = make_track((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), (0.11 * KM, 0, 0))
    assert summarise(track).heading == "N"


def test_summary_is_frozen():
    with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
        make_summary().name = "other"


def test_format_layout():
    assert format_summary(make_summary()).splitlines() == [
        "Walk",
        "  distance  12.3 km",
        "  ascent    +450 m / -120 m",
        "  altitude  1500-2100 m",
        "  steepest  18.0%",
        "  time      5h 00m",
        "  heading   NE",
    ]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("hours", "expected"),
    [
        (5 + 7 / 60, "5h 07m"),
        (0.75, "0h 45m"),
        (12.0, "12h 00m"),
        (0.0, "0h 00m"),
        (2.999, "3h 00m"),  # rounds up across the hour
        (1 + 29.4 / 60, "1h 29m"),
        (1 + 29.6 / 60, "1h 30m"),
        (1 + 59.6 / 60, "2h 00m"),
    ],
)
def test_format_duration(hours, expected):
    assert f"time      {expected}" in format_summary(make_summary(hours=hours)).splitlines()


def test_format_rounds_numbers():
    summary = make_summary(
        gain_m=450.4, loss_m=119.6, lowest_m=1499.6, highest_m=2100.4, steepest_pct=17.96
    )
    lines = format_summary(summary).splitlines()
    assert "  ascent    +450 m / -120 m" in lines
    assert "  altitude  1500-2100 m" in lines
    assert "  steepest  18.0%" in lines


def test_format_of_summarised_track(climb):
    text = format_summary(summarise(climb))
    assert text.splitlines()[0] == "Climb"
    assert "  time      3h 00m" in text
    assert "  heading   N" in text
EOF
